That night, for the first time in years, he wrote something in his journal besides the weather.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光洒在空荡的马路上，没有行人，只有偶尔驶过的出租车。便利店的灯光透过玻璃窗映在人行道上，店员靠着柜台打哈欠。远处的高楼大多熄了灯，只有几户人家还亮着孤零零的窗。风从巷子口吹过，带着一点凉意和清洁车洗过路面的湿气。流浪猫在垃圾桶边逡巡，偶尔抬头看一眼空无一人的街道。整座城市像是在喘息，积蓄着白天的喧嚣还没醒来的力气。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling a smaller version of itself, like a set of nesting dolls where each one holds a tinier one inside.\n- Every recursive function needs a stopping point, called the base case, otherwise it would keep going forever like an infinite hall of mirrors.\n- Each step hands off a slightly smaller piece of the problem to the next call, until the base case is reached and the answers travel back up to build the final result."}
